clauses.clause: ≥ 20 civilians, ≥ 6 soldiers, ≥ 4 staff, ≥ 8 animals (all 5 species, ≥ 2 zebras, ≥ 3 flamingos); outside-wall infected cannot cross; nobody idle > 3 s.
clauses.note: Initial production census at both tiers has20local civilians plus12carried humans,4staff,6soldiers and8animals in all5species (2zebras,3flamingos). Every calm tick tracks purposeful activity, facing and movement: maximum idle-facing-nowhere0.6s (<3s); current physical calm paths show posted guards, pedestrians and varied production clips under actual lighting. Four outside-wall ordinary-runner capability probes per tier cross0walls; no NPC disappears or dies during calm. Unmodified natural native final hashes equal independent controls. Outside-threat fixtures are disclosed, not natural spawns.
